I'll check your AWS account identity and then retrieve service quota information for key services.

PLAN: Run `aws sts get-caller-identity` to get account ID and ARN
PLAN: Run `aws service-quotas list-service-quotas` to see available service quotas
PLAN: Run `aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A` for EC2 instance limit
PLAN: Run `aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code vpc --quota-code L-0EA8095F` for VPC limit
PLAN: Run `aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code s3 --quota-code L-3819A6DF` for S3 bucket limit
